title: Travel agency and the chaos oracle
content:
I want the freedom to travel the world through an evolving set of possibilities. My chaos oracle is being developed around algorithms that alter priorities as circumstances change and leave room for serendipity. That freedom is part of what the local handover is intended to preserve.

The larger purpose includes openings for Massive Change: places where people, useful knowledge, resources and a systemic opportunity might come together. It also includes curiosity, culture, music, spiritual inquiry, rest and the experience of being alive in different places. The priorities are personal as well as practical.

## How the next place changes

The chaos oracle works with a changing field of choices. A new invitation, a research opening, an event, an unexpected conversation, a change in cost or my own wish to explore might alter the priorities. The itinerary stays open to change.

Its proposed algorithms bring several kinds of information together: what matters to me, what is becoming possible, how a place connects with the wider work, what the journey would involve and what I might miss by planning too tightly. Different weights produce different suggestions. A useful suggestion explains its reasons and what would change it.

Serendipity remains an active part of the design. An unplanned meeting might reveal a better question than the one I arrived with. A place might become worth a longer stay. An apparently indirect route might bring together people who would otherwise never meet. I want the system to leave space for those discoveries and learn from them.

The choice remains mine. The oracle supplies context and possibilities. My interests and judgement also change as I travel.

## The connected tools

| Project | Its role in this life |
|---|---|
| [Strange But True Travel Oracle](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/strange-but-true-travel-oracle/) | Developing the personal context, destination dossiers, changing priorities and serendipity records that feed the future oracle |
| [Australian Visa and Activity Atlas](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/Australian-visa-activity-atlas/) | Investigating both entry permission and permission for the actual activity, such as speaking, research, teaching, creative work or a business meeting |
| [Global Founder Atlas](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/global-founder-atlas/index.html) | Finding and comparing funding, residencies, research placements, paid pilots and other opportunities, with a preference for preserving ownership |
| [Right Place, Right Time](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/right-place-right-time/index.html) | Exploring patronage, sponsorship and useful exchanges that could support my ability to be where an opportunity opens |
| [Cosmic Nexus connections](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/strange-but-true-cosmic-nexus/connections.html) | Linking travel strategy, shared cultural experiences, science questions, civic tools and neighbouring projects |
| [GAJRA Earth concept site](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/gajra-earth-claude-build/index.html) | An earlier doorway into the continuing inquiry about Joyful Responsible Abundance, intelligent systems and international participation |

The projects retain their own purposes and development states. The Travel Oracle currently prepares structured material for a future oracle. The Founder Atlas has its own opportunity-scoring method. Right Place, Right Time explores the support relationship around a mobile systems builder. Bringing their information together is part of the wider design.

## A possible decision cycle

1. Gather the present context: interests, energy, resources, unfinished work and places that draw my attention.
2. Bring in openings: invitations, events, research, useful work, cultural experiences and opportunities for systemic progress.
3. Compare the practical conditions: entry and activity permissions, route, cost, timing and the actual people involved.
4. Reweight the possibilities, explain the resulting priorities and leave room for an unexpected opening.
5. Choose, travel, observe and feed what I learn into the next comparison.

This cycle would repeat as the field changes. A recorded decision gives the next iteration something to learn from. A route is one possible result at that moment. The next round may produce a different priority.

## A simple example

I might be considering a stay in one place when an invitation elsewhere connects a researcher, a useful material process and a community interested in shared ownership. The oracle would bring that possibility into view alongside travel conditions, the people involved and the work already under way.

An unplanned cultural encounter might then reveal a different opportunity, or I might choose to stay where I am because the present relationships deserve more time. The architecture supports that change of direction. It leaves room for the experience to change my priorities.

Those connections could feed a grounded Redlands question: a useful way to organise a business succession, support a learner, produce a film, compare an energy option or develop a community computing service. The local relevance would be explained with the source and the questions still open.

## CYOA in the local relationship too

You would keep doing your usual work. If you choose to explore this architecture, you would receive a new stream of opportunities and systemic targets that may be useful within it. Some inputs would arise locally; others might come through my travel, research or wider conversations.

The invitation is Choose Your Own Adventure from the beginning. You would choose what to read, question, share or pursue. An input is a possibility to consider. Interest and exploration remain non-binding.

My continuing contribution needs a viable income and a realistic way of staying in touch across places and time zones. Where people choose to carry a local activity, its everyday work would have the people and support it needs while I follow the wider opportunities.

## Reading the older itinerary material

The supplied Global Chaos Theory Itinerary explores an eleven-year horizon, changing priorities and possible routes towards July 2035. Its starting dates, annual sequences and numerical targets are earlier scenario material. The governing intention here is the evolving chaos oracle, with algorithms altering priorities and room for serendipity. [D21](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

The project pages establish tools and ideas available for examination. A fully connected live oracle, support arrangement or international partnership would have its own operating record. Current opportunities and consequential conditions need their own checks.

title: Transport energy and material capability
content:
Transport, energy, computing and materials form the physical capability behind many of the programme's social goals. People need to reach work and care, goods need to arrive, equipment needs reliable power, and useful assets need maintenance throughout their life.

The local proposals connect these needs with ownership, training and resilience. Each has its own business and engineering questions. The council handover would help establish a sensible sequence and the people responsible for developing it.

## Moreton Bay mobility

The [Moreton Bay Autonomous Mobility](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/moreton-bay-autonomous-mobility/index.html) proposal explores regional passenger movement, goods delivery and air services between mainland and island locations. The aim is wider access across the day and year, where technology, approvals, conditions and a viable operation permit it.

The programme includes hubs, charging, maintenance, recovery and local capability. Existing operators and workers belong in the ownership and transition discussion. An automated vehicle still sits within an operation with responsibilities to passengers, staff, the public and the environment.

An early study would choose a specific journey and compare the real alternatives: travel time, reliability, accessibility, fare, staffing, maintenance, energy, weather limits and the connection at each end. A supplier's demonstration elsewhere would be useful evidence, with its conditions made clear. It would not establish approval for a Redlands route.

## The ferry terminal is one related public decision

The Queensland Government's Dunwich Ferry Terminal Upgrade has a confirmed **$41 million** commitment through the South East Queensland City Deal. As at the TMR update of 29 September 2026, the business case was due in late 2026 and planning was expected to continue into 2027. The public consultation ran from 28 May to 21 June 2026. [S19](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s19) [S20](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s20)

My [Dunwich / Gumpi Open Data Lab](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/dunwich-gumpi-ferry-terminal-open-data-lab/) is developing evidence and a competing approach for consideration. It explores site records, public data, visualisation and simulation. It is not yet a complete independently costed alternative business case.

The handover's purpose is the wider relationship and programme. The terminal is one concrete place where better public evidence, access and connected planning matter. The consultation report also makes clear that consolidation of ferry services is outside the upgrade's project scope. A wider proposal would therefore need its own pathway.

## Energy as a shared local capability

[Straddie Clean Energy Superpower](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/straddie-clean-energy-superpower) brings together solar generation, batteries, heat, thermal storage and research into other resources and technologies. Wave and tidal energy, wind concepts, hydrogen and mineral opportunities appear as questions to examine, with differing levels of maturity.

The practical inquiry begins with demand, land and ecological conditions, connection options, storage duration, maintenance and cost. A project needs to say whether it supports a building, a service, a local network or export. Those uses have different requirements and revenue arrangements.

Mutual Futures adds an ownership question: how would the local benefits be held and shared? The proposed cooperative adds a capability question: who learns to operate and maintain it? The disaster work adds a continuity question: what still functions during an outage?

## Excavation, corridors and material use

[Sandworm Subterranean Systems](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/sandworm-subterranean-systems) explores underground transport and utility corridors with possible uses for excavated material. Geopolymer products, manufactured forms, heat storage and other ideas need actual sampling, testing and environmental assessment.

Sand and other excavated material vary. A useful manufacturing process depends on composition, processing, inputs, product quality, energy, transport, waste and a market or public use for the result. An attractive diagram of a circular system leaves those measurements to be done.

The staged proposition is to develop useful infrastructure and material capability first, then use what is learned to judge the next step. [The generation cities chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Disaster-resilience-and-generation-cities) explains the much larger horizon that these early capabilities might support.

## A place for grants and practical support

The [Stradbroke Grants Lab](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/stradbroke-grants-lab/) helps connect a defined project with a suitable funding opportunity, evidence, budget and reporting. Funding windows change, and eligibility belongs to the actual applicant and programme.

For the handover, a useful early contribution would be a shared project brief for each active proposal: purpose, current evidence, responsible people, next decision and resources needed. That makes it easier for council and other participants to help without being asked to approve the whole physical vision at once.

title: Disaster resilience and generation cities
content:
The disaster resilience inquiry began for me around the 2011 south-east Queensland floods. It now reaches from everyday community capability to the long-term continuity of human and other life through severe disruption.

The local and global parts belong together. People need useful arrangements for the hazards they already experience, while a much longer research programme examines what would be required to sustain civilisation through rarer and more severe events.

## Resilience starts with ordinary capability

The [Aura disaster resilience project](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-disaster-resilience) connects people, working groups, information, care, equipment and formal local disaster arrangements. A useful local system knows who is responsible for an activity, what resources are available, which people have agreed to help and how a task reaches completion.

For example, a group arranging regular transport or checking a shared facility already learns about access, maintenance and the people who rely on it. Those relationships can improve preparedness when formal arrangements define the group's role during a disruption. The same is true of food, energy, communications, disability support and care.

Information helps when it is current, understood and acted on by somebody with the relevant responsibility. A dashboard that lists a need without an accepted task and follow-through leaves the need unresolved.

## Different hazards require different responses

| Hazard or disruption | Examples of capability worth examining |
|---|---|
| Flood, storm or isolation | Local access, shelter, supplies, backup power, care continuity and communication |
| Prolonged infrastructure failure | Repair capability, spare parts, local production, diverse supplies and workable offline arrangements |
| Severe space weather | Power-system resilience, protected equipment, communications alternatives and observation |
| Asteroid impact | Detection and deflection, location-specific effects and continuity planning |
| Extreme solar or geophysical hypotheses | Clear mechanisms, competing models, observations and a defensible basis for any design assumptions |
| AI and superintelligence transition | Human agency, technical safety, resilient institutions, shared benefits and ways to challenge decisions |

These are different fields of inquiry. A single structure does not automatically protect against every hazard. A useful design states the conditions it is intended to withstand and the systems on which it still depends.

## The generation city horizon

The [subterranean cities concept](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/subterranean-cities.html) explores settlements that combine life above ground, below ground and eventually beyond Earth. The intention is continuity across generations, with enough productive capability to maintain a worthwhile life over a very long period.

The present generation-city idea, provisionally named Avallónë, reaches towards a settlement for 20 million people. That scale is a long-horizon design question. It is not a proposed approved population allocation for Minjerribah or a demonstrated engineering capacity. [D06](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

The ambition includes food, water, energy, material cycles, maintenance, medicine, learning, cultural life, governance and room for personal choice. Success would mean a place people want to inhabit, with viable institutions and the ability to renew its systems. Joy, art, play and belonging are part of the brief.

## A sequence that can learn

The Grain by Grain narrative proposes a progression from a useful Dunwich gateway and park-and-ride connection, through tested uses for excavated material, to further corridors, manufacturing and later settlement capability. Each step would have a useful purpose and its own assessment before expansion.

On Minjerribah, groundwater, ecology, geology, cultural heritage, land tenure, access and community decisions are fundamental to any actual underground proposal. A simulation can compare layouts and demands. Site investigation and specialist design establish what the ground and proposed systems can support.

For a long-duration habitat, the questions become demanding: how does air remain suitable, what happens during fire or flooding, how are people evacuated, how is food produced, which components fail, and how are repair skills and materials retained? A credible programme makes those questions visible rather than assuming future technology resolves them all.

## Asteroids and extreme solar research

Asteroid detection and deflection are established fields. NASA's DART mission demonstrated a kinetic-impact method of changing an asteroid moonlet's motion. That is an important result within a wider planetary defence effort. [S25](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s25)

Severe space weather has documented effects on power, communications, navigation and satellites. [S26](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s26) A proposed periodic solar micronova is a separate hypothesis. My current research audit identifies unresolved mechanisms, timing and recurrence claims, including problems in parts of the older source material. [The observation chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Observation-science-and-the-Solar-Swarm) explains how I want to investigate those questions.

Preparing useful local capability does not depend on a prediction of imminent global catastrophe. The large horizon provides a reason to investigate continuity seriously, while evidence determines which specific claims and design assumptions survive scrutiny.

## A local path you might choose

The immediate invitation is to explore the possibilities alongside your usual work. You might choose an everyday resilience question, follow a source or connect the idea with people already doing related work. The planetary research and generation-city horizon remain visible in the whole architecture, with grounded local starting points and further involvement chosen along the way.

title: Observation science and the Solar Swarm
content:
The research layer asks how people could observe, compare and debate major Earth and space processes more openly. It connects public scientific records, proposed sensor systems, simulations and a culture of correction.

This matters to the whole programme because a large resilience proposal needs a clear account of the conditions it is responding to. Observation and interpretation deserve their own records. The proposed response then needs evidence that it would help.

## The Virtual Solar Swarm

The [Virtual Solar Swarm](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/virtual-solar-swarm/) is a public mission-design and learning studio. Its present catalogue contains 384 bodies, with models for instruments, orbits, launch windows, fleet allocation, communications and replacement cycles. It lets a reader change assumptions and see how a proposed observing network changes.

The originating question was put to students at the SDNx Innovation Lab in Kolhapur, Maharashtra, in June 2019: if transport and cost were solved elsewhere, what sensor packages would you send to the solar system's most interesting objects? The present studio is a later independent design exercise. The people who attended that event are not thereby endorsers of the current proposal.

The current site distinguishes measured source data from mission design assumptions. It describes its physics as suitable for teaching and comparison, rather than spacecraft operations. No fleet described there has been funded, built or launched through this project.

The earlier Solar Swarm report explored roughly 1,500-2,000 satellites around about 200 objects and a network of solar observation nodes. Those figures describe one study configuration. The current interactive work gives readers choices rather than treating that configuration as a decided procurement. [D08](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

## What a real observation network would need

The useful question for every proposed instrument is what it measures and which uncertainty that measurement would reduce. A full mission also needs power, thermal control, calibration, pointing, data storage, communications, navigation, maintenance or replacement, and a real launch and operating plan.

Communication obeys light travel time. A solar-system network has delays, bandwidth limits, conjunctions and outages. Local autonomy and a clear control hierarchy become part of the design. An older report's assumed instantaneous communication through quantum entanglement is not a working communications capability and is not carried forward here.

Costs in a simulation depend on the assumptions entered. They help compare designs; they do not establish money raised or an approved budget. A useful next research package would define a smaller scientific question, compare existing missions and data, and identify what additional observation would add.

## Space weather and the micronova inquiry

[Micronova and Excursions](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/micronova-and-excursions/sitemap.html) is a public inquiry into claims about solar activity, geomagnetic change, excursions and severe events. Its current audit takes objections seriously. It identifies weak recurrence and timing claims, unresolved mechanisms, failed predictions and erroneous magnetic-decline figures in some older material.

That is the position to carry into the handover. Documented solar flares, coronal mass ejections and geomagnetic disturbances have observable consequences. A claim of a periodic catastrophic solar event requires its own mechanism, evidence and predictions. Similar names used for different stellar phenomena do not settle the proposed solar mechanism.

The productive research route is to state competing models, identify observations that distinguish them, and record which claims change when evidence changes. A hypothesis becomes more useful when its possible failure is clear.

## The Sensorium and public scientific debate

The Web3 Sensorium proposal explores shared records for observation, scientific discussion and review. A sensor record needs its instrument, location or orbit, time, calibration, uncertainty and processing history. A conclusion needs a traceable path back to those records. [D09](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

Public participation can help people ask questions, inspect evidence and notice gaps. Specialist review remains important where instruments, models or statistical methods are difficult to assess. Access to raw data and a clear correction trail make that review more useful.

Related space-weather and earthquake material explores automated alerts and a goal of highly specific forecasting. Those are research aims. The material does not demonstrate a validated ability to forecast an earthquake within an hour and 100 kilometres. [D18](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

## The local connection

The Cultural Intelligence Node, living twin, screen network and learning programmes could help people work with environmental data and understand uncertainty. Universities, researchers, instrument makers and space organisations would be prospective collaborators for larger studies.

One path you might choose is helping people examine the research and connect it with useful local questions. A scientific claim would stand on its evidence as we explore the possibilities together.

title: Australia and international cooperation
content:
The international proposal is for Australia to help countries cooperate through the AI and superintelligence transition, shared resilience work and peaceful development. It includes middle powers, small states and the superpowers in the same field of relationships.

My current statement of that direction is A Fair Go in the Age of Intelligence, the refined personal contribution prepared for UNGA 81 in September 2026. It invites the development of GAJRA Earth, the Global Association for Joyful Responsible Abundance on Earth, through locally rooted associations. It is my proposal, rather than a United Nations programme or an agreement already made by governments. [D04](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

## A fair go as an organising idea

The fair go offers a useful Australian starting point: a real opportunity to participate, understand, contribute and benefit as capability grows. In the international proposal, this includes room to question friends, work across differences and avoid making a smaller country dependent on a single larger power or supplier.

The proposed role includes cooperation with the United States, China, India, Europe, Pacific countries and other partners according to the work involved. It respects the distinct interests and choices of those countries. Australia's own history and present inequalities also belong in the conversation. A fair go is a continuing test of conduct, rather than a claim that Australia has already achieved it perfectly.

## GAJRA Earth and locally shaped associations

Joyful Responsible Abundance asks what makes life worth living, who and what we take responsibility for, and which useful capabilities become more widely available. Different languages, cultures, faiths and generations will understand the relationship between those ideas differently.

The proposed associations would explore those meanings through reflection, public dialogue and practical work. They could share methods, evidence, learning and joint projects while retaining their own judgement. The present direction gives no central association a general veto over the others. [D04](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

The garland image behind gajra is useful: connection lets the distinct parts form something together. The important practical work is deciding how a real association is governed, how it handles money and records, who it represents, and how it resolves disagreement. The [GAJRA Earth project](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/GAJRA-earth-infinity) is developing public material around that direction; it is not evidence that the proposed worldwide association has already been registered.

## Human values and AI alignment

Before asking AI to align with human values, people need richer ways to examine what they value, where they differ and how their actions affect others. Aura offers a personal setting for reflection. Public gatherings and P4A offer shared settings. Mutual Futures gives the productive and distributive questions an economic form.

The intended result is a living, permissioned understanding of human difference and common possibilities. It does not presume that everyone converges on one authorised global value system.

This social work complements technical AI safety. Testing models, limiting dangerous capabilities, understanding failures and keeping institutions accountable remain substantial tasks. A values process alone does not demonstrate control of a superintelligent system. Equally, technical capability alone does not decide who benefits or what people want their lives to become.

## Practical common work

Several fields offer a reason to cooperate despite wider political disagreements:

- Shared scientific observation and the transparent comparison of competing explanations.
- Food, water, energy, health and repair capability that improves everyday life and resilience.
- Skills, paid learning and productive ownership during economic transition.
- Peaceful space development and the sharing of useful research.
- Public evidence, parliamentary exchange and ways to understand decisions across institutions.
- Cultural work that makes other people's hopes, circumstances and concerns more intelligible.

The supplied background papers explore AUKUS-related choices, the Pacific, Fiji-Australia relationships, peaceful space development and partnerships involving Indigenous communities. They are proposal material with their own assumptions and dates. The current invitation is best carried through clearly defined work with willing partners. ## Why Queensland relationships matter

Kevin Rudd's Asia Society role and Milton Dick's IPU presidency create prospective avenues for different parts of the conversation. Asia Society is relevant to regional dialogue and understanding. The IPU is relevant to exchange between parliaments. Neither relationship is established by mentioning it here.

Brisbane 2032 also creates a long period of international attention. The useful contribution would be work people can actually inspect: a local ownership example, a cultural programme, practical civic tools, accessible learning or a well-framed scientific collaboration.

## The relationship with the Redlands handover

The local programme gives the global argument a place to learn. The international programme offers relationships and knowledge that may help local work. Each keeps its own responsibilities and resources.

This is why my preference is to share useful local possibilities while I develop the wider network. You would keep doing your usual work and choose which inputs to explore. My chaos oracle would help alter travel priorities as openings for Massive Change emerge, while leaving room for serendipity. Useful knowledge and connections could then flow back into grounded local opportunities. [The travel chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Travel-agency-and-the-chaos-oracle) explains that relationship.

title: The long game
content:
The programme has several horizons. There are useful things to do in the coming months, a council term to understand, the international attention around Brisbane 2032, a major cultural date in July 2035 and a much longer resilience and human development inquiry.

These dates help organise attention and preparation. The work at each stage still needs its own purpose, participating people and resources.

## A shared calendar

| Date or period | Public event or programme horizon | Meaning for this work |
|---|---|---|
| 23 November 2011 | Bruce Mau's State Library lecture | The setting of our first meeting |
| 16 March 2027 | Beginning of the final part of the present council term | The current legal route for filling a mayoral vacancy changes |
| 2028 | Next ordinary local government election | A council continuity point for any local programme |
| 22 July 2028 | Total solar eclipse crossing part of Australia | A possible occasion for public science, culture and shared attention |
| 25 November 2030 | Another Australian total solar eclipse | A further occasion within a sequence of preparation |
| On or before 2031 | Purple Party for Australia's objective to seed and trigger a national Australian referendum on establishing a Cyber Republic | The constitutional horizon for the proposed grassroots movement |
| 23 July-8 August 2032 | Brisbane Olympic Games | A period of international attention and a proposed civic demonstration horizon |
| 24 August-5 September 2032 | Brisbane Paralympic Games | A related focus on access, participation and capability |
| 13 July 2035 | Live Aid's 50th anniversary | The central date for my proposed art, music and values gathering |
| 13 July 2037 | Total solar eclipse with a path through Brisbane | A later public occasion, on the same calendar date as Live Aid |
| 26 December 2038 | A fourth coming Australian total solar eclipse | A further shared astronomical event |
| 2045 and beyond | Future of Life and the generation-city horizon | An authored long-term inquiry into futures worth inhabiting |

The eclipse dates come from astronomical sources. Totality occurs along particular paths, so these are four Australian eclipses, rather than four total eclipses visible from Brisbane. [S21](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s21) [S22](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s22) The Games dates are published by the Olympic movement. [S23](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s23) Live Aid took place on 13 July 1985. [S24](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#s24)

## July 2035

The 50th anniversary of Live Aid is a key date in my long game. The proposal brings together art, music and three days of reflection on past, present and future. The public process would invite people to explore what Joyful Responsible Abundance means, what they want to carry forward and what they want to make possible.

The three-part gathering appeared in earlier Aura material with a July 2025 target. That was an earlier proposal, rather than an event shown to have taken place. The current horizon in this handover is July 2035. [D01](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents) [D04](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents#supplied-background-documents)

The anniversary provides a cultural reference and a date. It does not establish an affiliation with the Live Aid organisations or permission to use their identity. The proposed gathering would have its own organisers, programme and agreements.

## The eclipse sequence

I describe the eclipses as etheric signs because they carry personal symbolic meaning for me. A rare shared event can bring people's attention to a longer span of time and prompt reflection on their place in it. That is a statement of meaning, distinct from an astronomical explanation or evidence of a predicted catastrophe.

The 2037 Brisbane eclipse falling on 13 July has a particular resonance with the 2035 gathering's anniversary date. It is a calendar connection. People would be free to take meaning from it in their own way.

Practical participation could include science, film, music, intergenerational learning and ways for people in different places to share the occasion. Each local programme would need accurate information and appropriate arrangements for the actual event.

## Brisbane 2032 and the years leading to it

The Games offer a visible horizon for work already useful to the people here. Accessible participation, community media, practical learning, better public evidence and a credible shared-ownership example would each have value before visitors arrive and after they leave.

The proposed Olympic and P4A demonstrations are my programme ideas. Their development would involve actual hosts and organisers. A strong local record would make a later invitation easier to assess.

## Beyond a single term or event

[Future of Life 2045](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/Future-of-Life-2045/) preserves an earlier authored future, developed around a 2022 contest entry and a longer inquiry going back further. It is useful as a record of direction, rather than a forecast.

The handover seeks continuity across these horizons. A council relationship can help the local work grow roots. An operating group, useful enterprises and a public record give it a life beyond any one officeholder, event or founder's availability.

title: Making the handover work
content:
The handover is **CYOA: Choose Your Own Adventure, from the get go**. You keep doing your usual work. If you choose to explore the possibilities, you gain a new stream of opportunities, systemic targets and whole-system architectures to draw on, with grounded local starting points.

You choose what to read, question, connect with, try, revisit or leave alone. The invitation and exploration are non-binding. The handover begins by making useful understanding and possibilities available.

## The direct line I'm asking for

I'm asking for a direct line of communication between us, with reasonably prompt replies and a straightforward way to put relevant ideas in front of you, without heavy gatekeeping. It needn't be private or exclusive. Public conversations and ordinary council channels are welcome.

I'd like to share relevant possibilities directly with you and hear what you think in a reasonably prompt exchange. You remain free to follow a thread, ask a question, pass something on or leave it there.

## Several ways in

| If this catches your interest | A possible path |
|---|---|
| A local need or opportunity | Begin with the particular people, place or decision |
| Ownership and livelihoods | Explore Mutual Futures and a possible business succession |
| Culture and public life | Follow the screen network, local stories or a creative activity |
| Personal intelligence | Explore Aura and the full Genesis proposal, including HBOT and the proposed Truth Engine |
| Democracy and constitutional change | Examine Purple Party for Australia and its public civic workbench |
| Resilience and the long horizon | Follow the links from everyday local capability into material, habitat and observation research |

The paths connect, and a reader is free to change direction. A question may be the most useful contribution. Somebody may find a connection to work already under way.

## What would arrive in the stream

A useful input would connect a concrete opening with the larger architecture around it. It might concern a local business succession, a place, a cultural programme, a technology, an overlooked need, a funding opportunity or a person with relevant capability.

| Part | What the reader would receive |
|---|---|
| Local starting point | The actual person, need, place, asset or decision involved |
| Opportunity | What might become possible and why the timing matters |
| Systemic target | The arrangement affecting the outcome, such as ownership, access, information, learning or coordination |
| Wider architecture | How the opening connects with other capabilities and the longer purpose |
| Evidence and uncertainty | The source, date, present status and questions still open |
| A possible next step | A conversation, comparison, visit or small piece of work worth considering |

This gives the grander ambition a practical entrance. A business succession is a local conversation with real people and accounts; it might also open a route into mutual ownership, paid learning and the distribution of productivity gains. A cultural activity might improve a public conversation while creating skills and relationships useful elsewhere.

## You carry on with your usual work

Your present responsibilities, relationships and interests remain the setting in which you would consider these inputs. You might use an idea, pass something on, introduce people, challenge an assumption or follow a thread further.

The direct line would let me put a relevant input in front of you and receive a reasonably prompt response. Each input remains a choice about what interests you, and the conversation is welcome in public as well as through ordinary council channels.

Your feedback may reveal a better route, a person already doing related work or a problem the architecture has overlooked. That becomes useful input for the next iteration too.

## If people choose to do something

The next step would fit the particular activity. An introduction needs people willing to meet. A film night needs a willing host and people to run it. A business succession needs a willing owner and a serious look at the business. A clinical activity needs its appropriate providers and consent.

As an activity develops, the people choosing it would work out who does what, which resources are available and what they want to learn. A service or continuing programme may later involve paid roles and formal arrangements appropriate to that work. Those details arise from the path people choose.

The first conversation remains an opportunity to explore.

## The civic path in full

P4A means **Purple Party for Australia**. Its objective is to seed and trigger a national Australian referendum on establishing a Cyber Republic on or before 2031.

Its present position is a website and public civic workbench. I have undertaken no outreach for P4A and have no confirmed support from anyone. It is not a registered political party and has no party members. Exploring its questions carries no membership or political commitment.

The [P4A chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/P4A-law-and-democratic-participation) gives the fuller explanation. The personal Genesis invitation and the wider local possibilities are also paths people choose for themselves.

## My freedom to follow the wider possibilities

I want a viable income, a place to live, creative and research time, and freedom to travel through the changing priorities of my chaos oracle. Emerging openings for Massive Change and serendipity are part of that life.

The [travel chapter](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Travel-agency-and-the-chaos-oracle) explains the connected tools and the evolving choice of where to be. A useful local relationship would let me share what I discover while people here continue the things they choose to carry.

My ongoing contribution also needs a practical way to be supported. Paid design work, a commission, patronage, licensing or another suitable arrangement would depend on the actual opportunity. The discussion starts with what is interesting and useful.

## Where the handover begins

We could start with a few examples connected to your present interests and see which threads you want to follow. You might explore them yourself, point out a connection or invite somebody else into a conversation.

The overview provides the map and the source trail. The next adventure is open.

The [Open Record](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/open-record-luke-nathan-hayes) and [project directory](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Project-directory) provide routes into the public material. A public software build demonstrates the workbench and its stated functions; an operational service would have its own people, support and record.

## The decisions at the centre of the handover

| Question | What would resolve it |
|---|---|
| How do we keep the conversation open? | A direct, reasonably prompt line between us, without heavy gatekeeping; public conversation and ordinary council channels are welcome |
| What catches your interest? | Your choice of a thread, question, opportunity or connection |
| Would a stream of inputs be useful? | A format and frequency that suit your interest and usual work |
| What happens if people want to try something? | Practical next steps shaped around the activity they choose |
| Who carries a continuing activity? | People willing to carry its actual work, with the support it needs |
| How does my ongoing work remain viable? | Suitable income and support that preserve my research, creative work and evolving travel choices |
| Are you interested in full Genesis? | Your informed personal decision, followed by the required clinical and practical arrangements |
| How would you engage with P4A? | A defined level of involvement and an accurate public description |
| Which sites and partners are ready? | Place-specific conversations with the actual people entitled to decide |

## Clarifications that govern this edition

I remember our first meeting during Bruce Mau's November 2011 visit. The public event records confirm that visit, while the separate video interview you made with me remains to be found. My intensive law reading belongs later, in 2012-13.

C-Hours retain their reciprocal meaning throughout. Older commercial descriptions are not treated as a change in my intention. Money, ownership and paid roles have their own arrangements.

The council vacancy threshold is 16 March 2027 under the current law. Occasional acting mayor duties do not determine succession. The handover is useful independently of a vacancy.

Amanda's new ministerial responsibilities date from 24 October 2026. Her federal and legal history remains part of the relationship context.

The current major cultural anchor is July 2035. Earlier July 2025 gathering material is historical proposal material, rather than a completed event.

P4A's objective is to seed and trigger a national Australian referendum on establishing a Cyber Republic on or before 2031. Its website is the present work; the grassroots movement remains an objective. Meetings about other projects are separate from P4A support.

The travelling life is guided by an evolving chaos oracle. Algorithms alter priorities and allow serendipity, including openings for Massive Change. Earlier itinerary sequences are scenarios, rather than a fixed schedule.

## Where evidence is still needed

Mutual Futures needs willing participants, enterprise information, a chosen legal and ownership structure, and a properly resourced operating model. A site proposal needs land and cultural agreements, design work and an operating group. A computing node needs actual workloads and a credible support and cost comparison.

Genesis needs its clinical, research, equipment and information arrangements. The Truth Engine needs evidence about its performance and errors. Material and underground infrastructure ideas need testing and site-specific engineering. The solar research needs clear mechanisms, distinguishing observations and review of competing accounts.

Each of those is a next piece of work, with a different kind of evidence. They are recorded here so an interested person can see where their skill or relationship would be useful.

## Keeping the record current

The public roles, project status, source versions and accepted responsibilities would be reviewed when something material changes. A short dated change note would explain what changed and why. Older documents retain their history while this overview gives the current explanation.

Revision of 25 October 2026: I am addressing you directly throughout this overview; my ask is a direct, reasonably prompt line of communication, without heavy gatekeeping or a need for privacy or exclusivity; CYOA and your continuing usual work are explicit; P4A's name, objective and current status are disclosed; and the travel and chaos oracle chapter explains the agency the handover is intended to preserve. A later update could record whichever threads you choose to explore.

The revision of **25 October 2026** explains my CYOA invitation, Choose Your Own Adventure, from the beginning. You continue your usual work and choose which inputs to explore. The invitation and exploration are non-binding.

The same revision records P4A as Purple Party for Australia, with an objective to seed and trigger a national Australian referendum on establishing a Cyber Republic on or before 2031. Its present status is a website and public civic workbench, with no P4A outreach undertaken, no confirmed support from anyone, no party registration and no party members. This is my current account of my work and intention.

## How the sources are used

The State Library, council, parliament, legislation and other institutional records support the public facts attributed to them. My repositories and websites establish what my projects currently propose or demonstrate. They do not establish an external organisation's agreement.

My account of our meeting, your video interview with me and the other meetings is personal recollection. The Mau lecture has a surviving public recording. The separate interview you made with me remains to be located.

Supplied documents provide background and version history. They are summarised here; private contact details and the original attachments are not reproduced. Some older AI-assisted documents overstate technical capabilities or describe C-Hours commercially. The current reciprocal definition and the clarifications in this wiki govern the handover.

## Bruce Mau and the 2011 visit

### S01

[State Library of Queensland: Nielson Design Lecture with Bruce Mau](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-3Zr3dsGq7I). Official lecture recording, 1:08:56. Its description identifies 23 November 2011 and Auditorium 1.

Contemporary announcement and interview giving the advertised lecture time and 24-26 November workshop dates. The [25 November report](https://www.indesignlive.com/articles/designing-our-future-bruce-mau) describes the event after it occurred.

### S03

[Library Board of Queensland Annual Report 2011-12](https://documents.parliament.qld.gov.au/tp/2012/5412T1444.pdf), printed page 26. Host record of Mau's visit, government discussions, North Quarter work and the world's first workshop in that named format. The relevant passage was recovered through indexed text; direct retrieval of the PDF was unavailable during research.

### S04

### S05

[Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago: Massive Change](https://mcachicago.org/whats-on/exhibitions/massive-change-the-future-of-global-design/). ## Supplied background documents

The current explanation keeps the ambition while correcting inherited overstatements. In particular, C-Hours are reciprocal; the Truth Engine is research-stage; health outcomes are not guaranteed; instantaneous quantum communication is not an available capability; and extreme-event hypotheses retain their unresolved questions.

The useful way to read the archive is as a developing body of work with identifiable revisions. This wiki supplies the coherent current account and a route back to the evidence.

title: Reading routes and glossary
content:
This is CYOA, Choose Your Own Adventure, from the get go. Read, question, compare, follow a connection or leave a path alone. The invitation and exploration are non-binding. The routes below are possible starting points, and each chapter links back to the main record.

## A possible path into our conversation

Read [The invitation to Paul](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/The-invitation-to-Paul), [Where we met and Bruce Mau](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Where-we-met-and-Bruce-Mau), [The whole system](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/The-whole-system), [Mutual Futures](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Mutual-Futures) and [Making the handover work](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Making-the-handover-work).

This route gives the personal beginning, the present invitation, the central economic proposal and a practical way to explore the relationship. Genesis and P4A also have their own paths. You keep doing your usual work and chooses whichever threads interest you.

## For council and local participants

Read [People and public responsibilities](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/People-and-public-responsibilities), [Ready S.E.T., shared work and computing](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Ready-SET-shared-work-and-computing), [Minjerribah sites and cultural relationships](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Minjerribah-sites-and-cultural-relationships), [Culture, screens and public participation](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Culture-screens-and-public-participation) and [Current position and open decisions](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Current-position-and-open-decisions).

For the mayoral question, explore [Mayoral options and personal agency](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Mayoral-options-and-personal-agency). For the travelling life and changing opportunities, explore [Travel agency and the chaos oracle](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Travel-agency-and-the-chaos-oracle). For transport or infrastructure, explore [Transport, energy and material capability](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Transport-energy-and-material-capability).

## For the wider horizon

Read [Australia and international cooperation](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Australia-and-international-cooperation), [The long game](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/The-long-game), [Disaster resilience and generation cities](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Disaster-resilience-and-generation-cities) and [Observation, science and the Solar Swarm](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Observation-science-and-the-Solar-Swarm).

These explain why a local handover matters to a programme reaching well beyond the region. The local commitments still follow their own agreements and evidence.

## For someone checking the record

Begin with [Sources and documents](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Sources-and-documents) and [Current position and open decisions](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Current-position-and-open-decisions). Use the numbered source links beside public claims and the [Project directory](https://github.com/auraofintelligence/Paul-overview-handover/wiki/Project-directory) for the original workbenches.

Personal recollections are identified as recollections. Proposed arrangements are invitations or designs. An actual service, installation or partnership needs its own record of people, resources and acceptance.

## Terms used in this wiki

| Term | Meaning here |
|---|---|
| Agency | A person's real freedom and capacity to choose and act in their own life |
| AI | Artificial intelligence, including the current tools and future systems being considered |
| Alignment | Work on the relationship between a system's behaviour, human intentions, values and consequences |
| Aura | The developing personal intelligence environment and related family of projects |
| C-Hour | One verified hour of voluntary human contribution, with no fixed financial value or redemption promise |
| Chaos oracle | A developing approach in which algorithms alter priorities as circumstances and opportunities change, with room for serendipity and the traveller's own choice |
| Co-design | Developing a proposal with the people who use, carry or are affected by it |
| CYOA | Choose Your Own Adventure: optional paths from the first step, with non-binding exploration |
| Cultural authority | The actual entitlement and responsibility to decide about particular cultural knowledge and its use |
| Cultural Intelligence Node | The proposed combination of local computing, people, records, learning and shared work |
| GAJRA Earth | Global Association for Joyful Responsible Abundance on Earth, a proposed network of locally rooted associations |
| Generation city | A proposed settlement with the capability to sustain worthwhile life across successive generations |
| Genesis | The proposed intensive Aura programme combining reflection, HBOT and Truth Engine development |
| Geode | The proposed embodied chamber and setting for intensive Genesis work, with several hardware research paths |
| HBOT | Hyperbaric oxygen therapy, with its individual clinical and equipment requirements |
| JRA | Joyful Responsible Abundance, the programme's guiding inquiry into worthwhile lives, consequences and shared capability |
| Living twin | A developing representation of a place and its processes, updated through selected records and observations |
| Mutual Futures | The central shared-ownership, succession, livelihood, learning and time proposal |
| P4A | Purple Party for Australia: currently a website and public civic workbench, with an objective to seed and trigger a national Australian Cyber Republic referendum on or before 2031 |
| Ready S.E.T. | Sustainable Employment and Training, the proposed cooperative work and capability layer |
| SI | Superintelligence, used here for a possible future capability substantially beyond present systems |
| Truth Engine | A proposed, research-stage approach to self-understanding and calibrated interpretation; its accuracy remains to be established |
| Verse Box | A proposed public interface for introductions to Aura, learning, contribution and participation |
| Workbench | A public tool or structured place for exploring evidence, choices and designs |
| XR | Extended reality, including immersive and augmented interfaces where useful |

## Returning to the purpose

The proposed relationship is simple to state even though the programme is broad: You keep doing your usual work and, if interested, gains a new stream of opportunities, systemic targets and whole-system architectures with grounded local starting points. I continue developing the wider work and following the evolving choices of my chaos oracle.

The next conversation follows whichever thread interests you. Further involvement grows from what people choose to explore and do.
